description: Fifth round: the index MXFP4 quantizer keeps a NaN (integer max on |x| bits, exponent clamp, zero codes for a non-finite group) against r6k's bytes and time, the NaN-input contracts with the clamp ReLU, and how the MMA reads scale 0xFF.
argv: import os, subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_relu5.py'])]; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/b' + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', ''), SWAP='indexer=/b/indexer_clamp_quant.py'); codes += [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'swap_plugin', '-rfEPxX', '-k', 'indexer or mxfp4 or index_keys or quantizer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_nan_inputs.py'], env=env)]; print('exit codes (quantizer bench, clamp + NaN-keeping quantizer tests)', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
